entities.summary: Louis Claude Noisette was a French horticulturist and botanist known for his contribution to the cultivation and hybridization of plants, especially roses. He is the author of Le Jardin Fruitier, a guide on the cultivation and history of fruit trees with illustrations by Pancrace Bessa.
